stem: Which of these is the most likely reason why the author uses a sweeping generalization?
instruction: Read this sentence from the article "Challenging the Status Quo." People find comfort in routine and familiarity. (paragraph 1)

options.label: A
options.text: To argue that change happens regardless for all people

options.label: B
options.text: To hint that the process of change is customary for most people

options.label: C
options.text: To help introduce the idea that change can be hard for people

options.label: D
options.text: To help suggest that change is something that puts people at ease
